geocoder.geocoder_provider.openstreetmap.yml
geocoder.settings.yml
---oauth/key---
key.key.openstreetmap.yml
key.key.openstreetmap_dev.yml
oauth2_client.oauth2_client.openstreetmap.yml
oauth2_client.oauth2_client.openstreetmap_dev.yml
--- git show info file ---
name: 'OpenCulturas - OpenStreetMap'
type: module
core_version_requirement: ^11
description: 'Exchange location data with openstreetmap.org'
package: OpenCulturas
version: 3.0.x-dev
project: openculturas
lifecycle: experimental
lifecycle_link: 'https://www.drupal.org/project/openculturas/issues/3507490'
dependencies:
  - 'ctools:ctools'
  - 'key:key'
  - 'oauth2_client:oauth2_client'

configure: openculturas_openstreetmap.settings

config_devel:
  install:
    - key.key.openstreetmap
    - oauth2_client.oauth2_client.openstreetmap
  optional:
    - field.field.node.location.field_osm_id
    - field.storage.node.field_osm_id

observation.command: cd /workspace; ls config/sync | grep -i geocoder; echo "---oauth/key---"; ls config/sync | grep -iE "oauth2|key\."; echo "--- git show info file ---"; git show HEAD:profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml
